messages:
nina_cs: Quick alert - Falloway Health onboarding showing rising costs on document-summarize flow. p95 ~390ms, p99 ~980ms, avg tokens ~920. Renewal touchpoint in 2 weeks. Any low-risk perf nudges we can propose?

ashok_ml: Two low-friction suggestions: 1) int8 quant profile on compact model for summaries, 2) route requests >1k tokens to compact variant. Both should cut token spend ~15-25% with small quality delta.

mike_sre: I can spin up a 5% canary pool and attach token-length routing. Need acceptance criteria and rollback.

rachel_success: Acceptance: p95 <300ms OR cost per 1k tokens -20% AND summary quality delta <=1.0% (ROUGE/embedding-sim). Immediate rollback if error_rate >1.5% or client flags quality.

ashok_ml: Canary snippet:

```yaml
canary: falloway-compact-int8-canary
steps:
  - pct: 5
    model: redwood/compact-v3
    quant: int8_profile_D
    cache_prefix: true
    fallback: redwood/llm-standard
  - wait: 4h
  - pct: 25
metrics:
  - p95_latency
  - summary_quality_delta: "<=1.0%"
```

mike_sre: Applying routing rule: {"route":"token_length","threshold":1000,"dest":"falloway-compact-int8-canary","fallback":"llm-standard"} and provisioning 5% pool. deploy-bot will confirm.

deploy-bot: Canary "falloway-compact-int8-canary" scheduled by mike_sre. Start epoch 4698770000. Alerts: p95>300ms, error_rate>1.5%, quality_delta>1.0%.

rachel_success: I'll set a short enablement call with Falloway eng to walk tradeoffs and capture edge-case prompts. Also prepare one-pager for legal/account.

nina_cs: Thanks team. Plan: 1) enablement call Mon 09:30 PT, 2) run 5% canary 72h, 3) collect client examples and evals, 4) scale to 25% only if p95 <300ms and quality_delta <=1%. Will update thread after call. :thumbsup:
